data.description: A general description of the weather during a collecting event.
The accession number with which the event is associated
Alpa-numeric identifier associated with an event such as "expedition number".
The temperature of the water, as measured during a collecting event. Enter a number in value and select an appropriate scale unit from the code table.
The temperature of the air, as measured during a collecting event.
A particular underwater event that includes or is included in the event (e.g., SCUBA, ROV, AUV, submersible).
A particular voyage on a vessel that includes or is included in the event.

Reference to field notebooks, maps, and/or other materials that document the event. Tip: Publications can also be used to reference event documentation and provide another path for associating documentation with events.
Relative humidity of the air, as measured during a collecting event expressed as a percentage.
Coordinates as provided from field notes, collector, object tag, or other data source.
Description of methods applied at the event.
Description of administrative actions capturing or otherwise affecting event data (e.g., date and determiner of data entry into legacy databases)
A vehicle (typically a ship or boat) that participated in the event.

metadata.label: Event Attributes
metadata.description: Event Attributes are assertions which enhance individual events.
